protocol.selection: Within versions passing the predeclared old error/scooter guard, maximize pooled labeled-box recall, then F1, then precision. Exact ties prefer incumbent, then fewer changed profile fields. Also disclose the unrestricted recall-first winner and its guard result.
protocol.guard: Zero matched car/truck/bus boxes on the five earlier reported fixtures/cargo objects across the original two 90-frame webcam clips; retain the passing Seoul car, parked Taiwan car and both checked Taiwan scooters.
protocol.metrics: Official pinned TrackEval: IoU 0.5 CLEAR box matches, MOT17 distractor/zero-marked preprocessing and published UA-DETRAC ignored-region handling. Pedestrians are person; UA-DETRAC car/bus/van/others are one vehicle group. This does not measure car-versus-truck type accuracy or motorcycle recall.
protocol.scope: First eight seconds per original source, all 25/30 FPS frames retained. Round 1 uses two four-second prefixes, round 2 adds two sources, round 3 extends all four to eight seconds. Final two sources are opened for current-profile evaluation only after freeze.
protocol.history: All six parent recordings appeared in earlier project benchmarks. Deferred means not used for current tuning, not completely unseen historical or pretrained data.
limitations: Short segments and repeated adjacent-frame object appearances are not unique people/vehicles.
These box/tracking scores are not the earlier property doorway-crossing metrics.
Road vehicles and pedestrian benchmarks do not validate property parking, new-camera generalization, motorcycle accuracy or hourly counts.
Known error guards constrain selection; unrestricted recall-first winners are disclosed separately.
